purpose: Per-cause inventory for the BUN corpus, the mirror of unreached-inventory.json. Exists because the bun side had only a single net number (green 868, -16 against the last per-file run) and no structure to dispatch against. The node inventory is what let wave 3 return 150% of target after wave 2 returned 3.7%.
how_to_use: Group by cause, count files per cause, budget mechanisms x 10min + ~55min per-agent overhead. Never budget a MANIFESTATION bucket as a mechanism.

bun-internal-for-testing-LAYER.cause: bun:internal-for-testing exists in mbun but is only partially populated (highlightJavaScript, createSocketPair, ... in yaml_block_markdown.cppm). Tests destructure a namespace that is absent and die with "Cannot destructure property 'X' from null or undefined value" -- often inside a SPAWNED subprocess, so the visible failure is an empty-stderr assertion rather than the destructure itself.
bun-internal-for-testing-LAYER.LAYER_NOT_CAUSE_WARNING: This is the bun-side analogue of internalBinding. Measured precedent on the node side: clearing the internalBinding layer on 35 files converted 3 and merely transferred the rest to other failure families. Budget as ENABLING INFRASTRUCTURE with a DIAGNOSIS target ('what do these files fail on once the namespace exists'), NEVER as a conversion target of 107.
bun-internal-for-testing-LAYER.action: largest structural item on the bun side and entirely unmapped until now; start with cssInternals (13) since it is the densest single namespace
bun-internal-for-testing-LAYER.counting_note: The symptom count (files failing with "Cannot destructure property 'X' from null") is the DEMONSTRATED lower bound; 107 files import the module and would need it populated, but most of those fail for other reasons first. My first count of this cause was 1 because I grepped the LOGS for the module name -- the logs carry the destructure error, not the import. Count the symptom, not the string you expect.

registry-unreachable-NOT-AN-MBUN-DEFECT.cause: These fail with 'Failed to build service <mysql|postgres>_plain: failed to solve: <image>: failed to resolve'. docker IS usable in this environment; the container REGISTRY is not reachable, so the image cannot be pulled. Nothing about mbun is exercised.
registry-unreachable-NOT-AN-MBUN-DEFECT.why_not_reclassified: tools/integration/manifests/blocked-external.txt reclassifies a file ONLY when it TIMES OUT, and these FAIL. Reclassifying them would require changing the classifier's contract, which changes what the published number means -- and it would move the number in the flattering direction. Recorded as read-context instead. Verified they are not among the 43 files that lost green, so the -16 regression is unaffected.

redis-not-implemented.cause: mbun throws its own explicit 'Redis commands over a live socket are not yet implemented in mbun (DEFERRED)'. An honestly-declared gap, not a bug.
redis-not-implemented.action: architectural; a Redis client round of its own

caller-location-in-stack-trace.cause: bun's test runner needs to resolve a caller frame ("Couldn't find caller location in stack trace"). One mechanism -- stack-frame introspection fidelity under JSC -- plausibly covers all of them.
caller-location-in-stack-trace.action: verify one file before budgeting the block

bare-value-divergence-UNSPLIT.cause: NOT A CAUSE. 113 files whose first mismatch is 'Expected: N / Received: N' and 23 'true | false'. These identify nothing on their own. Recorded explicitly so the block is not mistaken for a mechanism -- the same trap that cost three rounds on the node side.
bare-value-divergence-UNSPLIT.action: split per file; never hand this bucket to an agent whole

no-first-failure-marker.cause: 214 files whose failure form the extractor does not recognise. This is a TOOLING gap, not a corpus fact: until they are parsed, a quarter of the bun failure surface is invisible to cause analysis. Improving the extractor is worth more than fixing any single file.
no-first-failure-marker.action: highest-value next tooling step on the bun side

regression_debt.sampled_10_of_43: 1 genuinely ahead-of-reference (assert/deep-equal, 22 of 22 failures are stale test.failing markers), 9 real. Sampled causes -- util.styleText not applying colour, a SharedArrayBuffer snapshot returning empty, >2GiB buffer edges, path.parse, url -- all look like plain gaps rather than node-vs-bun contract conflicts, so they are 'fix them' work and do not need an arbitration decision.
regression_debt.verified_not_my_round: regression/issue/24374 (TLS + checkServerIdentity) fails identically on a binary WITHOUT this round's tls verify change, so that change is not implicated.
